title: Analog Filter Design
text: Design and implement analog filters, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Filter type} sets Filter type; {Design method} sets the filter design, {Filter order}, {Passband edge frequency (rad/s)}, {Lower passband edge frequency (rad/s)}, {Upper passband edge frequency (rad/s)}, {Stopband edge frequency (rad/s)}, {Lower stopband edge frequency (rad/s)}, {Upper stopband edge frequency (rad/s)}, {Passband ripple in dB} and {Stopband attenuation in dB}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Design method
params.values: Filter design Butterworth (default) | Chebyshev I | Chebyshev II | Elliptic | Bessel

params.name: Filter type
params.values: Filter type Lowpass (default) | Highpass | Bandpass | Bandstop

params.name: Lower passband edge frequency (rad/s)
params.values: Lower passband edge frequency 30 (default) | scalar value

params.name: Upper passband edge frequency (rad/s)
params.values: Upper passband edge frequency 80 (default) | scalar value

params.name: Lower stopband edge frequency (rad/s)
params.values: Lower stopband edge frequency 30 (default) | scalar value

params.name: Upper stopband edge frequency (rad/s)
params.values: Upper stopband edge frequency 80 (default) | scalar value
